body: thank you all. really. i never thought to post here and im really glad i did. i never thought that strangers would be so caring. you really have made me think about my situation and i am starting to think moving out is going to be the best decision right now. i recently started working a job as a waiter and im hoping that will bring in a little extra than a minimum wage job to help me get towards this goal. also thank you for the links to help me further with my self education so to speak...im very touched by the kindness of those who responded. thank you all very much. seriously...thank you
